summary: Full main-paper extraction of tame parahoric integral Shimura models, with minuscule fixer embeddings, punctured-Witt-disc torsor purity, corrected tensor displays, abelian-type descent and nearby-cycle test functions. Partial because recursive original-source and declaration-sized proof closure remains explicit; no implementation claim.

items.name: Witt-vector coefficient carrier
items.statement: For prime p and perfect field k of characteristic p use the existing p-typical Witt vectors W(k), with coefficient sequence indexed by natural numbers; its fraction field supplies L. This item is only the coefficient carrier, not a crystalline site.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L01.ofCoefficients
api.statement: Reuse WittVector.mk on a coefficient sequence.

api.name: KP18.L01.ext
api.statement: Equality follows from equality of every coefficient.

api.name: KP18.L01.fractionField
api.statement: The map to L preserves the existing ring operations.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: For p>2 and a complete Noetherian local R with perfect residue k, W_hat(R) is the Zink subring W(k)⊕W_hat(m_R), where the second summand consists of Witt coordinates tending m_R-adically to zero; I_R is the kernel of W_hat(R)→R.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: A frame is (S,I,φ,φ1) with I+pS⊂Jac(S), φ a Frobenius lift modulo p, φ1:I→S φ-semilinear with generating image, and φ|_I=pφ1; strict maps preserve these maps and ideals.

items.name: Frobenius on the Witt fraction field
items.statement: For a perfect domain k of characteristic p, the Witt Frobenius induces a ring automorphism of FractionRing(WittVector p k).
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L02.inverse
api.statement: The inverse is induced by inverse Witt Frobenius over a perfect domain.

api.name: KP18.L02.ofWitt
api.statement: The fraction-ring automorphism commutes with the inclusion of W(k).

api.name: KP18.L02.onRational
api.statement: Frobenius fixes the prime-field fractions.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: Reuse the existing carrier and the explicitly limited comparison stated here.

items.name: Connected reductive group predicate
items.statement: Reuse the finite-type commutative Hopf-algebra property expressing smoothness, geometric connectedness and trivial geometric connected normal smooth unipotent subgroups.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L06.geometricRadical
api.statement: Reuse the geometric normal-unipotent-subgroup characterization.

api.name: KP18.L06.baseChange
api.statement: Transport the predicate through permitted field extensions.

api.name: KP18.L06.iso
api.statement: Transport reductivity under Hopf-algebra isomorphisms.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: A local Hodge-type pair (G,{μ}) over Q_p admits a faithful minuscule representation ρ:G→GL(V), whose image contains scalars and sends {μ} to the class of diag(a repeated d,1 repeated n−d).

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: For a smooth closed G⊂GL(Λ), choose tensors s_a∈Λ^⊗ whose scheme-theoretic stabilizer equals G over every base algebra. The tensor notation includes the required duals and finite tensor operations.

items.name: Algebraic torus predicate
items.statement: A finite-type affine group over a field is a torus when its coordinate Hopf algebra becomes that of a finite-rank split torus after extension to an algebraic closure.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L07.fromSplitting
api.statement: A geometric split-torus isomorphism proves the predicate.

api.name: KP18.L07.geometricFiber
api.statement: The geometric fiber has the specified finite rank.

api.name: KP18.L07.iso
api.statement: Transport the torus predicate along an isomorphism.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: A torus T/K is R-smooth if its schematic closure in the Néron lft model of Res_{L/K}T_L, for a splitting extension L, is smooth; this is independent of L. A reductive G is R-smooth if the centralizer of a maximal breve-K split torus is R-smooth.

items.name: Geometric character lattice
items.statement: Use the additive group of group-like elements of the geometrically extended coordinate Hopf algebra, with its absolute Galois action. For a torus this is X*(T).
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L08.galoisAction
api.statement: Expose the action inherited from geometric scalar extension.

api.name: KP18.L08.charactersAsMaps
api.statement: Identify a character with a group-scheme map to G_m.

api.name: KP18.L08.addCharacters
api.statement: Addition of characters corresponds to multiplication of their values.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: A local Hodge-type pair (G,{μ}) over Q_p admits a faithful minuscule representation ρ:G→GL(V), whose image contains scalars and sends {μ} to the class of diag(a repeated d,1 repeated n−d).

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: For split connected reductive G/k and dominant character ν, V_ν=Ind_B^G(−w0ν)^* is the Weyl module used in the Finkelberg–Mirković bounds, with its weight decomposition and root-operator action in characteristic p.

items.name: Cocharacter lattice and pairing
items.statement: For a torus use geometric group-scheme morphisms G_m to T, their integral-dual comparison to X*(T), and the evaluation pairing. Its Galois action is contragredient.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L09.dual
api.statement: Use the integral-dual linear equivalence.

api.name: KP18.L09.pairing
api.statement: Evaluate a character on a cocharacter as an integer exponent.

api.name: KP18.L09.galois
api.statement: The dual action evaluates against the inverse Galois action on characters.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: Reuse the existing carrier and the explicitly limited comparison stated here.

items.name: Perfect character-cocharacter pairing
items.statement: For a torus over a field, its integral character-cocharacter pairing is perfect.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

items.name: Closed dominant chamber of a root pairing
items.statement: For an ordered coefficient ring and a root-pairing base, the closed dominant chamber consists of vectors on which all simple coroot functionals are nonnegative. For cocharacters apply the dual root-pairing convention.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L11.mem
api.statement: Membership is nonnegativity on the simple coroot functionals.

api.name: KP18.L11.zero
api.statement: The zero vector lies in the closed chamber.

api.name: KP18.L11.interior
api.statement: Strict positivity implies membership in the closed chamber.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: For coweights λ and μ in a fixed based root datum, λ≤μ means μ−λ is a nonnegative integral sum of simple coroots. Write λ_dom for its unique Weyl-dominant representative.

items.name: Unique dominant representative in a Weyl orbit
items.statement: For a finite reduced crystallographic root system over a strictly ordered ring, with the flipped pairing reduced, each Weyl orbit meets the closed dominant chamber in exactly one vector. Rationalization and the central torus direction of a reductive group are separate adapters.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

items.name: Abelian variety over a field
items.statement: Reuse the existing proper geometrically integral group scheme over a field, with its derived smooth and commutative structure. This supplies A_x, not a universal abelian scheme.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L13.groupScheme
api.statement: Expose the existing group scheme and structure map.

api.name: KP18.L13.fieldExtension
api.statement: Base change is the existing abelian variety base change.

api.name: KP18.L13.properSmooth
api.statement: Use properness and derived smoothness without rebuilding the carrier.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: Reuse the existing carrier and the explicitly limited comparison stated here.

items.name: Divided-power structure
items.statement: Use DividedPowers on an ideal of a commutative semiring, including its zero-outside-the-ideal convention and divided-power identities. A compatible PD enlargement still requires new geometry.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

api.name: KP18.L15.dpow
api.statement: Use the existing divided-power operations on the ideal.

api.name: KP18.L15.product
api.statement: The product of divided powers has its binomial coefficient.

api.name: KP18.L15.basePD
api.statement: An enlargement includes compatibility with the base PD operations.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: For a divided-power thickening B→R satisfying the continuous nilpotence and compatibility conditions of §5.1, enlarge the Zink frame using the logarithmic Witt coordinates; extend V^-1 by zero on the divided-power kernel component [b].

items.name: Finite free cocharacter lattice
items.statement: For a torus over a field its integral cocharacter module is finite free.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

items.name: Galois invariance of the pairing
items.statement: For a multiplicative-type group, simultaneously applying a Galois automorphism to character and cocharacter leaves their integral pairing unchanged.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Only the cited pinned declarations are existing implementation evidence. The downstream API and tests specify requested reuse or adapters; they do not claim uninspected wrappers are built.

items.name: Coxeter Bruhat order
items.statement: For a Coxeter system cs on a group W, BruhatLE is the reflexive transitive closure of reflection multiplication steps strictly increasing cs.length. The pin supplies a partial order; the affine group and its comparison to the geometric order remain separate.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Read the existing declaration rather than rebuilding Bruhat order.

api.name: KP18.L18.data
api.statement: Expose reflection steps and their reflexive transitive closure.

api.name: KP18.L18.transport
api.statement: Restriction to the affine Coxeter subgroup uses the same length and steps.

api.name: KP18.L18.characterization
api.statement: BruhatLE is reflexive, transitive and antisymmetric for the given Coxeter system.

uses.where: KP18 §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
uses.how: Define the admissible inequalities.

items.name: Extended buildings and facet fixers
items.statement: For a connected reductive group over the specified nonarchimedean local field, construct its extended building, reduced adjoint building, facets and group action, with functorial extension to splitting fields.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Bruhat–Tits smooth stabilizers and connected parahorics
items.statement: Construct the smooth affine integral fixer and its neutral parahoric for a building point, retaining the Kottwitz distinction between the full fixer and connected fixer.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Affine Weil restriction
items.statement: For a finite locally free base extension and affine finite-type scheme, represent the restriction-of-scalars functor; export base change and the induced group structure.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Pinned root subgroup maps
items.statement: For a split pinned Chevalley–Demazure group scheme, use root maps x_alpha, their Chevalley relations and base change, with the differential matching the pinning.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Equal-characteristic affine Grassmannian
items.statement: The fpqc quotient LG/L+G represents group torsors on R[[t]] trivialized over R((t)); bounded Schubert varieties and their closure relations are supplied by the equal-characteristic Grassmannian owner.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Dieudonné and nilpotent deformation theory
items.statement: Contravariant Dieudonné modules classify p-divisible groups over perfect residue fields; nilpotent divided-power thickenings admit the corresponding Hodge-filtration deformation theory.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Integral p-divisible group classification
items.statement: Use the Breuil–Kisin integral comparison for p-divisible groups over the relevant mixed-characteristic complete DVR, with tensors requiring the separate display continuation.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Formal moduli and Artin approximation
items.statement: Relate completed local rings to deformation functors and prove the Artin algebraization/approximation comparison under its exact excellence and finite-presentation hypotheses.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Siegel and PEL good-level moduli
items.statement: Use the moduli of polarized abelian schemes with endomorphisms, Rosati and determinant conditions and sufficiently rigid prime-to-p level. Representability and smoothness here require the good-prime and no-p-level hypotheses of M2; parahoric chain moduli are the distinct supplier S38.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Canonical generic Shimura models
items.statement: Use complex adelic Shimura varieties, reflex fields and canonical models with their away-p Hecke action and connected components.
items.locator: §§1–4, foundational carrier imported with the limited scope below
items.note: Stage scope read; this is a planning supplier, not an implemented theorem. Original-source hypotheses remain an explicit closure obligation.

items.name: Kottwitz component homomorphism
items.statement: For connected reductive G/K, fix the Kottwitz map G(Kur)→π1(G)_I. The neutral parahoric points of a full bounded fixer are its intersection with the kernel.

api.name: KP18.G01.mk
api.statement: Construct the quotient π1 from the cocharacter/coroot lattice with inertia action.

api.name: KP18.G01.characterisation
api.statement: Identify the neutral subgroup by the kernel, not by boundedness alone.

api.name: KP18.G01.map
api.statement: Transport under central and unramified maps.

uses.how: Transport under central and unramified maps.

items.name: Extension of a central quotient to fixer models
items.statement: A central quotient G→Gtilde of connected reductive groups extends to the corresponding full fixer and neutral models at compatible building points.

items.name: Smooth central kernel in connected parahorics
items.statement: For tame G and central kernel Z a torus or a finite group of order prime to p, its closure in Gx° is smooth. If Z is a direct summand of an induced torus, the closure is its connected Néron model.

items.name: Exact central quotient of connected parahorics
items.statement: Under G03, 1→closure(Z)→Gx°→Gtilde_x°→1 is fppf exact. The analogous full-fixer map need not be surjective.

items.name: Periodic graded lattice chain
items.statement: A graded O-lattice chain L in V is stable under K×, ordered by inclusion with strictly decreasing c:L→R and c(π^nΛ)=c(Λ)+n; retain a period of distinct lattices.

api.name: KP18.G05.mk
api.statement: Record the indexed lattices, inclusions, periodicity and grading.

api.name: KP18.G05.characterisation
api.statement: Its automorphism functor preserves every indexed lattice and inclusion.

api.name: KP18.G05.map
api.statement: Restriction of scalars and compatible chain maps induce stabilizer maps.

uses.how: Restriction of scalars and compatible chain maps induce stabilizer maps.

items.name: Almost self-dual symplectic chain
items.statement: For (V,ψ), require dual lattices in L and c(Λ∨)=−c(Λ)+m. Index so (Λi)∨=Λ(−i−a), a=0 or1. Its GSp fixer uses a single common multiplier.

api.name: KP18.G06.mk
api.statement: Construct the dual involution and common-multiplier stabilizer.

api.name: KP18.G06.characterisation
api.statement: Identify duality with the indexed reversal, including the offset a.

api.name: KP18.G06.map
api.statement: A symplectic chain isomorphism transports all pairings and multipliers.

uses.how: A symplectic chain isomorphism transports all pairings and multipliers.

items.name: Diagonal chain stabilizer is a closed immersion
items.statement: The smooth GL, GL_D or symplectic chain fixer embeds as the schematic diagonal closure in the product of its indexed lattice automorphism groups, with the compatibility equations.

items.name: Based toral building map
items.statement: For split G, a faithful representation decomposed through its irreducible quotient groups and compatible hyperspecial lattices determines the toral, G(Kur)- and Galois-equivariant building embedding of Proposition1.2.3. Equal characteristic also needs the stated root separability.

api.name: KP18.G08.mk
api.statement: Specify the base hyperspecial point and its image.

api.name: KP18.G08.characterisation
api.statement: Characterize the map by torality, stabilizer and central-translation compatibility.

api.name: KP18.G08.map
api.statement: Extend through the block Levi and descend to K-fixed buildings.

uses.how: Extend through the block Levi and descend to K-fixed buildings.

items.name: Quotient group preserves the chosen lattice
items.statement: The lattice stable under the source split integral group is stable under the integral quotient acting faithfully on its irreducible factor; prove this using root groups and torus weights rather than surjectivity on integral points.

items.name: Minuscule representation in characteristic zero
items.statement: A representation is minuscule if geometrically each irreducible summand has derived weights in a single Weyl orbit; trivial summands are allowed. This does not assert modular semisimplicity.

api.name: KP18.R01.mk
api.statement: Record the geometric irreducible summands and their weight orbits.

api.name: KP18.R01.characterisation
api.statement: Check minuscule highest-weight root pairings in the actual character lattice.

api.name: KP18.R01.map
api.statement: Direct sums and scalar extension preserve the predicate in characteristic zero.

uses.how: Direct sums and scalar extension preserve the predicate in characteristic zero.

items.name: Irreducible reduction of an integral minuscule lattice
items.statement: For split G and irreducible minuscule representation, the integral highest-weight lattice has irreducible reduction in residue characteristic p, as used from Jantzen II2.15.

items.name: Stable minuscule lattices are homothetic
items.statement: For a split integral reductive group and irreducible minuscule characteristic-zero representation, any two stable O-lattices differ by a scalar in K×.

items.name: Uniqueness up to real translation
items.statement: For a faithful irreducible minuscule representation, the two based toral building embeddings of §1.2 differ by a real translation in the GL center direction.

items.name: Integral highest-weight lattice with pinning
items.statement: Use the pinned Chevalley group and the integral divided-power negative-root operators on a highest-weight vector to construct the lattice Λλ. Specify the integral form before reduction.

api.name: KP18.R04.mk
api.statement: Construct the span of the prescribed integral root-operator monomials.

api.name: KP18.R04.characterisation
api.statement: Expose the weight decomposition and highest-weight line.

api.name: KP18.R04.map
api.statement: Pinned diagram automorphisms transport highest vectors and lattices.

uses.how: Pinned diagram automorphisms transport highest vectors and lattices.

items.name: Tame projective descent of an irreducible representation
items.statement: For an irreducible K-representation with D=End_G(V)^op and center K1, choose a highest-weight constituent over a tame splitting field. Its Schur projective action gives a cocycle in PGL defining End_D(V) and the descended G_K1→GL_D(V).

api.name: KP18.R05.mk
api.statement: Record the division algebra, center, constituent, cocycle and descent isomorphisms.

api.name: KP18.R05.characterisation
api.statement: Distinguish descent of End(Vλ) from descent of a vector basis.

api.name: KP18.R05.map
api.statement: Recover the K-representation by restriction of field and forgetting D-structure.

uses.how: Recover the K-representation by restriction of field and forgetting D-structure.

items.name: Galois-equivariant minuscule building map
items.statement: The canonical minuscule map to B(GL_D(V)) is equivariant for the splitting Galois group; descend fixed buildings and forget O_D-lattice structure to obtain the faithful toral embedding of1.2.26.

items.name: Equal-characteristic twisted minuscule representation data
items.statement: Supply the explicit restricted twisted Weyl-module decomposition and descent of §1.2.27 in equal characteristic. General modular representations are not asserted to admit this decomposition.

api.name: KP18.R06.mk
api.statement: Record each Weyl factor, descent cocycle and restriction-of-structure map.

api.name: KP18.R06.characterisation
api.statement: Require the minuscule root-separable restrictions used in the proof.

api.name: KP18.R06.map
api.statement: Transport with a compatible pinned change of splitting data.

uses.how: Transport with a compatible pinned change of splitting data.

items.name: Rank-one minuscule root strings
items.statement: The restriction of a minuscule weight module to a root SL2 has strings of length one or two, giving trivial or standard rank-one summands; faithful nontrivial root action supplies the root-group embedding.

items.name: Split minuscule fixer immersion
items.statement: For faithful minuscule split G and the specific Levi-compatible map of §1.2, the full fixer Gx embeds closed in GL at the image chain.

items.name: Tame fixed fixer comparison
items.statement: For a tame splitting extension, the original full fixer is the fixed subgroup of the Weil-restricted splitting-field fixer at the compatible building point.

items.name: Tame faithful minuscule fixer immersion
items.statement: For tame G/K of characteristic zero and a faithful minuscule representation, the embedding constructed in §1.2 gives a closed immersion of full fixer group schemes Gx→GLι(x).

items.name: Equal-characteristic fixer immersion
items.statement: With the explicit twisted minuscule data R06, the equal-characteristic version of G14 holds; no general modular decomposition is inferred.

items.name: Punctured Witt disc and p-adic boundary
items.statement: Put S=W(k)[[u]], D=Spec S, D×=D minus (p,u), and O_Ehat the p-adic completion of S_(p), with residue k((u)). Here k is finite or an algebraic closure of Fp.

api.name: KP18.U01.mk
api.statement: Construct the two open/boundary pieces D[1/p] and Spec O_Ehat over D×.

api.name: KP18.U01.characterisation
api.statement: Record their intersection with fraction field Ehat and the faithfully flat cover used for gluing.

api.name: KP18.U01.map
api.statement: Transport under the residue-field extensions in Step4.

uses.how: Transport under the residue-field extensions in Step4.

items.name: Induced-torus H1 vanishing
items.statement: For an induced K0-torus Q, H1(D[1/p],Q)=1; decompose through finite extensions and use the Picard group of the localized regular power-series ring.

items.name: Induced-torus H2 restriction vanishes
items.statement: For Q as in U02, the image of H2(D×,Q°) in H2(D[1/p],Q) is zero. Track the Brauer purity and henselian residue-field step; finite k is not strictly henselian.

items.name: Cohomological dimension for the algebraically closed case
items.statement: When k is algebraically closed of characteristic p, the fraction field of W(k)[[u]] has the dimension bounds used for Serre conjecture II in Lemma1.4.6. Do not use the value two over finite k: for ℓ≠p the latter field has cdℓ=3.
items.locator: Lemma1.4.6 proof; Hu2013 Theorem4.5 for finite-k diagnostic

items.name: Simply connected torsors on the generic puncture
items.statement: For k algebraically closed and quasi-split simply connected G/K0 with no E8 factors, H1(D[1/p],G)=1. This is the sufficient scope actually used in the first part of Proposition1.4.3.

items.name: Flasque resolution for the torsor argument
items.statement: Choose the central flasque resolution 1→Z→Gtilde→G→1 with Gtilde_der simply connected and induced abelian quotient. Under the cyclic tame splitting used here Z is a direct summand of an induced torus.

api.name: KP18.U06.mk
api.statement: Record the central resolution and induced quotient.

api.name: KP18.U06.characterisation
api.statement: Keep the cyclic-splitting hypothesis in the invertibility of the flasque lattice.

api.name: KP18.U06.map
api.statement: Extend to the neutral models through G04.

uses.where: §1.4 proof Step2 and listed consuming items
uses.how: Extend to the neutral models through G04.

items.name: Triviality over the completed boundary
items.statement: For algebraically closed k, torsors under the smooth connected parahoric become trivial over O_Ehat, using the cd-one residue field k((u)), its reductive quotient and unipotent radical.

items.name: Triviality on D[1/p] for the parahoric torsor
items.statement: In the algebraically closed tame no-E8 case, U03, U05 and the flasque resolution show that a parahoric torsor on D× is trivial over D[1/p].

items.name: Witt boundary double-coset factorization
items.statement: In the algebraically closed tame setup, G(S[1/p])\G(Ehat)/G(O_Ehat) is a singleton.

items.name: Parahoric torsor purity over algebraically closed k
items.statement: For a connected parahoric model of a tame reductive group without E8 factors, H1_fppf(D×,G)=1 when k is algebraically closed.

items.name: Finite-residue-field descent of parahoric purity
items.statement: The same parahoric H1 vanishing holds for finite k. Descend from W(kbar)[[u]], extend the affine descent datum across the missing codimension-two point and use Lang plus henselian smooth lifting on D.

items.name: Hartogs extension of affine torsor descent data
items.statement: On the regular two-dimensional disc, functions and morphisms to the relevant affine schemes extend uniquely from D×; this extends the parahoric descent cocycle once its trivialization is available after residue extension.

items.name: Vector-bundle and chain proof in the split hyperspecial-contained case
items.statement: For split parahorics contained in a hyperspecial, extend vector bundles over the regular punctured disc and use the chain cokernel projective-dimension argument to obtain free k[[u]] quotients; the parabolic dilatation argument proves the stated torsor purity.

items.name: Pappas–Zhu polynomial group and global Grassmannian
items.statement: For K/Qp unramified, tame G/K and its parahoric, use the smooth O_K[u]-group specializing at u=p and reductive after inverting u. Its global Grassmannian classifies torsors trivialized away from u=p.

api.name: KP18.M01.mk
api.statement: Construct the polynomial group, specialization and torsor-modification functor.

api.name: KP18.M01.characterisation
api.statement: Identify the generic fiber using the parameter t=u−p.

api.name: KP18.M01.map
api.statement: Transport the pinned tame descent data under base change.

uses.how: Transport the pinned tame descent data under base change.

items.name: Minuscule flat local model
items.statement: For the minuscule geometric class {μ}, let E be its reflex field and Mloc the scheme-theoretic flat closure of the generic orbit G/P_(μ^-1) in M01 over O_E. The orbit descends even if it has no E-point.

api.name: KP18.M02.mk
api.statement: Form the schematic closure over the reflex integers.

api.name: KP18.M02.characterisation
api.statement: Expose the generic flag variety with the inverse-cocharacter parabolic convention.

api.name: KP18.M02.map
api.statement: Base change with the chosen polynomial model and class.

uses.how: Base change with the chosen polynomial model and class.

items.name: Normal local model
items.statement: For M02 with p not dividing |π1(Gder)|, Mloc is normal.

items.name: Reduced special fiber and normal Cohen–Macaulay strata
items.statement: Under M03 the geometric special fiber is reduced; it has the stated smooth Schubert strata with normal Cohen–Macaulay closures.

items.name: Normality after finite reflex extension
items.statement: For every finite E′/E, Mloc base changed to O_E′ remains normal under M03.

items.name: Central quotient map of polynomial models
items.statement: A central quotient of tame groups extends to the compatible O[u]-models and induces the maps of their global Grassmannians.

items.name: Adjoint local-model normalization
items.statement: Under p∤|π1(Gder)|, the map to the adjoint local model identifies M_G with the normalization of M_Gad base changed to O_E; this supplies the adjoint parahoric action.

items.name: Derived-isogeny comparison of local models
items.statement: For a central isogeny Gder→G′der matching the adjoint μ and building data, if p∤|π1(G′der)|, the local models become isomorphic over the composite reflex field, equivariantly for the derived group map.

items.name: Symplectic factorization of the minuscule building map
items.statement: For the Hodge symplectic representation of §2.3.1, the chosen minuscule map B(G)→B(GL(V)) can be chosen to factor through B(GSp(V,ψ)).

items.name: Polynomial extension of the lattice-chain representation
items.statement: The pinned tame representation extends to compatible O[u]-lattice chains and group models; the equal-characteristic closure is smooth with the required neutral parahoric.

items.name: Closed symplectic local-model embedding
items.statement: For the tame Hodge embedding and chains constructed in §2.3, M_G embeds closed in the symplectic lattice-chain local model over O_E.

items.name: Polarized total lattice
items.statement: Take the indexed direct sum of the chain and its prescribed p-scaled copies with the total alternating pairing, giving Λ′⊂(Λ′)∨ and a faithful GSp embedding.

api.name: KP18.M12.mk
api.statement: Construct the total space, scaled lattice and pairing.

api.name: KP18.M12.characterisation
api.statement: Check inclusion in the dual using the index-reversal equations.

api.name: KP18.M12.map
api.statement: Transport indexed chain maps to the total lattice.

uses.how: Transport indexed chain maps to the total lattice.

items.name: Closed ordinary-Grassmannian local-model embedding
items.statement: After M12 the local model embeds closed into Gr(g′,Λ′), where 2g′=dim V′ and g′ is the Hodge weight multiplicity. The printed rank dim V′ on p162 needs this correction.

items.name: Zink coefficient frame
items.statement: For complete local R with perfect residue k and p>2, use What(R)=W(k) plus the decaying Witt vectors of m_R, I_R=ker(What(R)→R), and V:What(R)≃I_R with φV=p.

api.name: KP18.D01.mk
api.statement: Construct the decaying coefficient subring and its augmentation ideal.

api.name: KP18.D01.characterisation
api.statement: Retain the Verschiebung inverse on I_R and the Frobenius relation.

api.name: KP18.D01.map
api.statement: Continuous local maps transport the frame.

uses.how: Continuous local maps transport the frame.

items.name: Contravariant display
items.statement: A display is (M,M1,F,F1): M finite free over What(R), I_R M⊂M1 with M/M1 projective over R, semilinear F,F1, generating image of F1, and F1(V(w)m)=wF(m).

api.name: KP18.D02.mk
api.statement: Construct the four data with the frame relation.

api.name: KP18.D02.characterisation
api.statement: Export F|M1=pF1 and the generating condition.

api.name: KP18.D02.map
api.statement: Base change uses M1′=image(M1)+I_R′M′.

uses.how: Base change uses M1′=image(M1)+I_R′M′.

items.name: Normal decomposition and linearized display map
items.statement: When What(R) is p-torsion-free, a normal decomposition gives tilde(M1)=φ*L⊕pφ*T inside φ*M, finite free, and a display is equivalent to an isomorphism Ψ:tilde(M1)→M.

items.name: Display base change compatibility
items.statement: The display base change described in §3.1.6 commutes with the linearized image construction when both relevant Witt coefficient rings are p-torsion-free. For torsion bases use D07.

items.name: Dieudonné antiequivalence with displays
items.statement: The contravariant Dieudonné functor identifies p-divisible groups with displays over the complete local bases of §3.1; it is Zink’s covariant equivalence composed with Cartier duality and commutes with base change.

items.name: Universal filtered deformation pair
items.statement: Fix the residual Dieudonné module D and filtration D1, lift its flag parabolic, and let R be the completed flag variety at that filtration. The universal pair (M,M1) and a lift Ψ of Ψ0 yield a display deformation.

api.name: KP18.D06.mk
api.statement: Construct the completed flag ring and universal pair.

api.name: KP18.D06.characterisation
api.statement: Keep the residual identification in the deformation functor.

api.name: KP18.D06.map
api.statement: Pull back the universal pair and display along local maps.

uses.how: Pull back the universal pair and display along local maps.

items.name: Corrected relative-frame tilde functor
items.statement: Use KPZ26 §5.1.15–19: on a normal pair use a free τ with comparison diag(1,p) to φ*M, and on morphisms use the block rule (φA,pφB;φ1C,φD). The canonical first-order map goes from residual tilde to universal tilde.

api.name: KP18.D07.mk
api.statement: Construct τ through the relative frame, independent of normal decomposition.

api.name: KP18.D07.characterisation
api.statement: Keep the comparison map without assuming injectivity over p-torsion bases.

api.name: KP18.D07.map
api.statement: Prove block-map composition and canonical residual-to-universal transport.

uses.where: KP18 Lemma3.1.9 corrected by KPZ26 §5.1.15–19 and listed consuming items
uses.how: Prove block-map composition and canonical residual-to-universal transport.

items.name: Versal display deformation with the corrected first-order condition
items.statement: If Ψ reduces to the residual map via the canonical D07 transport modulo m_R²+pR, the induced deformation is versal. This replaces the invalid normal-decomposition proof of Lemma3.1.12.

items.name: Tangent lifting over a DVR
items.statement: For finite K/K0 and a point ξ:R→O_K, display deformations over O_K[ε] with residual identification correspond bijectively to lifts of ξ.

items.name: Canonical rational Frobenius-equivariant section
items.statement: For p-torsion-free complete local A with m_A^N⊂pA and a deformation of D, there is a unique rational Frobenius-equivariant lift D[1/p]→M_A[1/p] of the identity. Use the topology induced by a p-adic lattice after inversion.

items.name: Filtered comparison at a DVR point
items.statement: At A=O_K, evaluation of D10 on the de Rham module gives the weakly admissible filtered φ-module associated with the p-divisible group, through the Breuil divided-power ring.

items.name: Integral tensor deformation datum
items.statement: From §3.2 onward k is algebraically closed. Fix φ-invariant tensors sα,0 in D^⊗ reducing to Fil0, with smooth stabilizer G and connected reductive generic fiber, a tensor isomorphism φ*D≃D, H1(D×,G°)=1 and scalar homotheties in G.

api.name: KP18.D12.mk
api.statement: Record the tensors, stabilizer and three explicit hypotheses.

api.name: KP18.D12.characterisation
api.statement: Keep tensor, dual, symmetric and exterior operations compatible with variance.

api.name: KP18.D12.map
api.statement: A tensor-preserving isomorphism transports the datum.

uses.how: A tensor-preserving isomorphism transports the datum.

items.name: Tensor orbit deformation ring
items.statement: At a tensor-compatible characteristic-zero filtration, choose μ_y splitting it, take the closure of its G-orbit in the flag variety and complete at the residual point over O_E. Denote the result R_G; its local-model cocharacter is μ_y^-1.

api.name: KP18.D13.mk
api.statement: Construct the orbit closure and its completed ring.

api.name: KP18.D13.characterisation
api.statement: Record the quotient R_E→R_G and the inverse-cocharacter convention.

api.name: KP18.D13.map
api.statement: Transport under G-conjugacy with the chosen residual point.

uses.how: Transport under G-conjugacy with the chosen residual point.

items.name: Breuil–Kisin filtration lattice at a DVR point
items.statement: For S=W[[u]], Eisenstein E(u) and ξ:R_G→O_K, take F⊂D⊗S as the preimage of the Hodge filtration under u↦π. F is free; use E(u)μ_y(E(u))^-1 after local completion.

api.name: KP18.D14.mk
api.statement: Construct F as the inverse image of the filtration.

api.name: KP18.D14.characterisation
api.statement: Export the lattice formula after the E-adic completion and the projective-dimension-one proof of freeness.

api.name: KP18.D14.map
api.statement: Compare φ*F with the tilde pair under S→What(O_K).

uses.how: Compare φ*F with the tilde pair under S→What(O_K).

items.name: Tensor torsor of the filtration lattice
items.statement: The tensors lie integrally in F^⊗ and Isom_s(F,D⊗S) is a trivial G-torsor, under D12.

items.name: Integral tensors in the tilde lattice
items.statement: At every ξ:R_G→O_K, the tensors belong to the tilde filtration lattice and its tensor-isomorphism scheme is a G-torsor. E([π]) is a nonzerodivisor by ghost valuations, with coefficient Frobenius included.

items.name: Global integral tensor torsor over normal R_G
items.statement: If R_G is normal, the pointwise D16 tensors extend to the universal Witt module and the tensor-isomorphism scheme is a trivial G-torsor.

items.name: Tensor-preserving versal display with very-good input
items.statement: A tensor-preserving Ψ constant to first order exists and gives the adapted versal deformation when the corrected canonical transport preserves the tensors, i.e. the required very-good condition. Smoothness of G alone does not establish that condition.

items.name: Canonical Frobenius section preserves tensors
items.statement: If integral φ-invariant tensor lifts and a tensor-preserving Witt section exist, D10 preserves the tensors. Its approximating telescoping compositions preserve tensors, and the stabilizer condition is closed.

items.name: Four equivalent infinitesimal adaptedness criteria
items.statement: For the O_K[ε] deformation in Lemma3.2.14, factoring through R_G, every R_E lift factoring, rational transported tensors in Fil0, and integral transported tensors in Fil0 are equivalent in the corrected setup D18.

items.name: Adapted DVR deformation factors through R_G
items.statement: Under D12, normal R_G and D18, an O_K deformation with the prescribed G-cocharacter filtration and integral φ-invariant tensors admitting a tensor frame factors through R_G under every map from R_E inducing it.

items.name: Integral Breuil–Kisin module
items.statement: For S=W[[u]] with φ(u)=u^p, take finite free M with semilinear φ whose linearization is an isomorphism after E(u) inversion; Fil^iφ*M is the preimage of E(u)^iM.

api.name: KP18.D22.mk
api.statement: Construct the semilinear module and its linearized map.

api.name: KP18.D22.characterisation
api.statement: Expose the E-height and filtration formula.

api.name: KP18.D22.map
api.statement: Tensor, dual, symmetric and exterior operations use their specified height conventions.

uses.how: Tensor, dual, symmetric and exterior operations use their specified height conventions.

items.name: Fully faithful integral crystalline tensor functor
items.statement: The functor M from Galois-stable Zp lattices in crystalline representations to D22 is fully faithful, tensor compatible and compatible with symmetric/exterior powers. Its exactness here is asserted on the punctured disc.

items.name: Crystalline and de Rham realizations of the Kisin module
items.statement: For crystalline V=L[1/p], Dcris(V)=(M/uM)[1/p] with φ, and DdR(V)=φ*M⊗K with the stated filtration.

items.name: p-divisible Dieudonné comparison and dual convention
items.statement: For L=(TpG)^∨, the LINEAR dual, D(G)(What(O_K))=What(O_K)⊗_(S,φ)M(L), and the residual Dieudonné module is φ*(M/uM).

items.name: Galois image lies in the Kottwitz kernel
items.statement: For k algebraically closed and the crystalline G-representation specified in §3.3, its Galois image lies in ker κ_G.

items.name: Tensor trivialization on the Kisin module
items.statement: If the Galois image lies in G°(Zp) and H1(D×,G°)=1, then M(L)≃L⊗S preserving the Galois tensors.

items.name: Tame no-E8 full-fixer tensor comparison
items.statement: For G the full fixer of a tame no-E8 group, D26 places the image in G°, so D27 applies.

items.name: Integral crystalline and de Rham tensors of a p-divisible group
items.statement: Under D28, the crystalline tensors are integral in the residual module; they lift to integral φ-invariant Witt tensors, belong to Fil0 after de Rham evaluation, and yield the tensor-frame isomorphisms of Proposition3.3.8.

items.name: Cocharacter splitting of the integral Hodge filtration
items.statement: The tensor comparison gives a de Rham tensor isomorphism reducing to the identity and a G-cocharacter lift of the residual filtration, conjugate to the canonical generic filtration.

items.name: Étale tensor adaptedness criterion
items.statement: In the corrected normal/very-good deformation setup, a p-divisible O_K deformation with the prescribed generic G-cocharacter class and Galois-invariant étale tensors matching sα,0 factors through R_G under every inducing R_E map.

items.name: Hodge normalization model
items.statement: For a tame Hodge-type datum at p>2, p∤|π1(Gder)|, choose the good symplectic lattice embedding and sufficiently small prime-to-p level. Take the normalization of the schematic closure of the canonical generic Shimura variety in the corresponding Siegel model over O_(v).

api.name: KP18.S01.mk
api.statement: Construct the closure, normalization and finite-level generic-fiber identification.

api.name: KP18.S01.characterisation
api.statement: Record the universal abelian scheme and full-fixer level Kp=Gx(Zp).

api.name: KP18.S01.map
api.statement: Compatible prime-to-p level maps produce the inverse-limit model.

uses.how: Compatible prime-to-p level maps produce the inverse-limit model.

items.name: Absolute Hodge tensors and their realizations
items.statement: The tensors cutting out the Hodge group give generic de Rham and étale sections defined over the reflex field and compatible with the crystalline realization at specializing points.

items.name: Completed component of the Hodge closure
items.statement: The irreducible completed component of the unnormalized closure through a chosen specializing generic point is the completed local model at its Hodge filtration, using the corrected very-good display construction.

items.name: Completed normalized Hodge local rings
items.statement: The normalized Hodge model has, at a geometric special point after the indicated unramified base, the completed local ring of the corresponding local model.

items.name: Integral de Rham tensors
items.statement: The generic tensor sections extend integrally over the normal Hodge model and cut out the tensor-frame G-torsor. Track the homology/cohomology dual identifications.

items.name: Hodge local-model diagram
items.statement: Let Stilde be the G-torsor of tensor frames of the de Rham bundle. Send a frame to the pulled-back Hodge filtration in Mloc.

api.name: KP18.S06.mk
api.statement: Construct π:Stilde→S and q:Stilde→Mloc.

api.name: KP18.S06.characterisation
api.statement: π is a G-torsor; q is G-equivariant.

api.name: KP18.S06.map
api.statement: Prime-to-p level maps transport frames and filtrations.

uses.how: Prime-to-p level maps transport frames and filtrations.

items.name: Smoothness of the Hodge local-model map
items.statement: The map q in S06 is smooth of relative dimension dimG. Correct the proof of4.2.7 by using the smooth action map, as KPZ26 §7.3.1(1) specifies.

items.name: Reduced Hodge special fiber and admissible stratification
items.statement: The Hodge special fiber is reduced. If Kp=Kp°, its geometric special fiber has μ-admissible strata with normal Cohen–Macaulay closures.

items.name: Same-field henselization comparison
items.statement: At z∈S(Fq) with connected Kp=Kp°, there is w∈Mloc(Fq), unique up to G(Fq), with O^h_(S,z)≃O^h_(Mloc,w) over the base.

items.name: Reflex norm of local units
items.statement: The cocharacter norm map E×→G(Qp)/(Gsc(Qp)Kp°) kills O_E×.

items.name: Temporary global central-kernel condition
items.statement: For C=ker(Gsc→Gder), impose that c∈H1(Q,C) trivial at every finite ℓ≠p is also trivial at p. This is a temporary construction hypothesis removed by the auxiliary Hodge cover.

api.name: KP18.S11.mk
api.statement: Record localization maps and the stated implication.

api.name: KP18.S11.characterisation
api.statement: Separate this condition from injectivity at all places including infinity.

api.name: KP18.S11.map
api.statement: Transport through the selected derived-group cover.

uses.how: Transport through the selected derived-group cover.

items.name: Small-level rational stabilizers are connected
items.statement: Assuming S11, for sufficiently small K^p, G(Q)∩K⊂K°.

items.name: Connected-parahoric normalization
items.statement: Normalize S01 in Sh_(Kp°K^p); this defines S_(K°) and its map to the full-fixer model.

api.name: KP18.S13.mk
api.statement: Construct the generic cover and normalization.

api.name: KP18.S13.characterisation
api.statement: Retain the full-to-neutral component quotient.

api.name: KP18.S13.map
api.statement: Refine away-p level compatibly.

uses.how: Refine away-p level compatibly.

items.name: Connected normalization is finite étale
items.statement: Under the preceding hypotheses and S11, S13→S01 is finite étale; for sufficiently small K^p it splits over an unramified extension of O_E.

items.name: Unramified field of connected components
items.statement: The geometric connected components of the full-away-p connected-parahoric tower are defined over the maximal extension unramified at primes over p.

items.name: Module twist by an affine torsor
items.statement: For flat affine Z/A, a Z-torsor P and an A-module M with Z-action, define the twist as (M⊗_A O_P)^Z.

api.name: KP18.S16.mk
api.statement: Construct the invariant module with its descended A-structure.

api.name: KP18.S16.characterisation
api.statement: Export the canonical trivialization after tensoring with O_P.

api.name: KP18.S16.map
api.statement: Equivariant module maps and base change transport the twist.

uses.how: Equivariant module maps and base change transport the twist.

items.name: Faithfully flat twist descent
items.statement: The canonical map S16⊗_A O_P→M⊗_A O_P is an isomorphism.

items.name: Abelian scheme twist up to A-isogeny
items.statement: For a subring A⊂Q, finite-type flat affine Z/A, its torsor P and Z→Aut_A(B), define B^P by A-linear torsor descent in the A-isogeny category.

api.name: KP18.S18.mk
api.statement: Construct the fppf sheaf twist and its A-isogeny morphisms.

api.name: KP18.S18.characterisation
api.statement: After a finite integral torsion-free trivializing A-algebra it becomes the corresponding power of B.

api.name: KP18.S18.map
api.statement: Equivariant isogenies and base maps commute with twisting.

uses.how: Equivariant isogenies and base maps commute with twisting.

items.name: Representability of the abelian twist
items.statement: S18 is represented by an abelian scheme up to A-isogeny, using the finite torsor-trivializing algebra and connected kernel construction of Lemma4.4.6.

items.name: Weak polarization and character-compatible twist
items.statement: A weak A-polarization is an A-isogeny polarization modulo A×. If λ:B→B∨(c) is Z-equivariant for c:Z→Gm, its twist is the descended weak polarization of B^P.

api.name: KP18.S20.mk
api.statement: Construct the polarization class and c-equivariance condition.

api.name: KP18.S20.characterisation
api.statement: Identify (B∨)^P with (B^P)∨ and descent up to the torsor unit.

api.name: KP18.S20.map
api.statement: Equivariant polarized isogenies transport the weak class.

uses.how: Equivariant polarized isogenies transport the weak class.

items.name: Integral central action on the universal abelian scheme
items.statement: The schematic closure of Z_G in the integral group embeds in Aut_Z(p)(A_x), compatibly with its rational Hodge action.

items.name: Twisted prime-to-p level descends
items.statement: For the central torsor of γ∈Gad(Z(p))+, the composite involving γtilde^-1, the prime-to-p level frame and the twist trivialization is Galois-invariant and gives level γK^pγ^-1.

items.name: Arithmetic star product
items.statement: For Γ⊂H stable under Δ with equivariant φ:Γ→Δ whose induced action is inner, set H*_ΓΔ=(H⋊Δ)/{(γ,φ(γ)^-1)}.

api.name: KP18.S23.mk
api.statement: Construct the normal graph subgroup and quotient.

api.name: KP18.S23.characterisation
api.statement: Export maps from H and Δ with the amalgamation relation.

api.name: KP18.S23.map
api.statement: Compatible triples of homomorphisms induce star-product maps.

uses.how: Compatible triples of homomorphisms induce star-product maps.

items.name: Arithmetic component-action groups
items.statement: Construct A(G), A(G)°, B(G_Z(p)), and the parahoric A(G_Z(p)), Atilde(G_Z(p)) and neutral versions with the closures and star products of4.5.6 and4.6.3.

api.name: KP18.S24.mk
api.statement: Record each rational positive subgroup, center closure and finite-adelic factor.

api.name: KP18.S24.characterisation
api.statement: Distinguish parahoric arithmetic groups from full-fixer B.

api.name: KP18.S24.map
api.statement: Maps of compatible central derived covers induce the indicated maps.

uses.how: Maps of compatible central derived covers induce the indicated maps.

items.name: Adjoint twisting action on the integral model
items.statement: Twisting the universal polarized abelian scheme and level by S18–S22 extends the Gad(Z(p))+ conjugation action to the integral model and combines with G(A_f^p) to give B(G_Z(p)).

items.name: Lifted action on the adjoint frame torsor
items.statement: The action S25 lifts to the Gad-torsor obtained from S06; q is equivariant for trivial action on Mloc, and at small away-p level the induced map is smooth of relative dimension dimGad.

items.name: Descent of a rational model to Z(p)
items.statement: For an affine Q-scheme S and a flat affine Zp-model of S_Qp, intersect their coordinate rings in the Qp-coordinate ring to obtain the compatible Z(p)-model.

items.name: Derived closure and adjoint neutral quotient
items.statement: The derived closure in the Hodge fixer is the derived full fixer. If Z_G is connected or the derived center has order prime to p, the neutral component of G/Z equals the adjoint parahoric.

items.name: Arithmetic completion depends on the derived group
items.statement: A(G_Z(p))° is the completion of Gad°(Z(p))+ for the topology generated by images of Gder°(Z(p))+∩K^p; Atilde° is its specified closure before quotienting the p-level.

items.name: Galois component-stabilizer extension
items.statement: For a chosen connected Shimura component over E^p, let E(G°) be its stabilizer in A(G_Z(p))×Gal(E^p/E), and define Etilde before removing p-level.

api.name: KP18.S30.mk
api.statement: Construct the stabilizer as a subgroup with its Galois projection.

api.name: KP18.S30.characterisation
api.statement: Identify its kernel with the neutral arithmetic completion.

api.name: KP18.S30.map
api.statement: Pull it back along a composite reflex-field extension.

uses.how: Pull it back along a composite reflex-field extension.

items.name: Exact stabilizer extension and amalgamation identity
items.statement: The Galois projections in S30 are surjective with kernels A° and Atilde° respectively, and amalgamating with A recovers the full A×Galois action.

items.name: Derived-cover maps of Galois extensions
items.statement: A central derived isogeny inducing the same adjoint Shimura datum gives natural maps of S30 extensions after base change to E′=EE2.

items.name: Cartesian arithmetic component square
items.statement: The square comparing Atilde(G)°→Atilde(G2) with A(G)°→A(G2) in4.6.11 is Cartesian, giving a bijection of kernels and injection of cokernels.

items.name: Component-indexed induced Shimura model
items.statement: Using the representatives j of4.6.12, form the induced quotient of the connected Hodge component times A(G2_Z(p)) by A(G_Z(p))°. On the j-component use the conjugated p-level jKp°j^-1 required by KPZ26 §7.3.1(3).

api.name: KP18.S34.mk
api.statement: Construct the componentwise quotient with its correct conjugated level.

api.name: KP18.S34.characterisation
api.statement: Record the generic-fiber identification and semidirect Galois action.

api.name: KP18.S34.map
api.statement: Descend the Galois action over E′ and retain the G2(A_f^p)-action.

uses.where: Lemma4.6.13; Corollary4.6.15, corrected component indexing and listed consuming items
uses.how: Descend the Galois action over E′ and retain the G2(A_f^p)-action.

items.name: Freeness of the derived-cover descent kernel
items.statement: The kernel Δ(G,G2) acts freely on the connected integral Hodge model at the full away-p tower. It need not be finite.

items.name: Integral abelian-type descent and local geometry
items.statement: The quotient S34 descends to the composite-reflex integers, is an integral model of the abelian-type Shimura tower and is étale locally the auxiliary Hodge local model.

items.name: Descent of the adjoint local-model diagram
items.statement: The adjoint frame torsor and local-model map descend along S34; at sufficiently small finite away-p level the map is smooth of relative dimension dimGad.

items.name: Auxiliary Hodge cover of an abelian-type datum
items.statement: For tame (G2,X2) of abelian type, choose a Hodge datum with a central derived isogeny and identical adjoint datum. Require the five separate outputs S39–S43; use the corrected cover construction of KPZ26.

api.name: KP18.S38.mk
api.statement: Record the Hodge embedding and central derived map.

api.name: KP18.S38.characterisation
api.statement: Retain the abelian-type condition, including the Deligne vertex restriction in type D.

api.name: KP18.S38.map
api.statement: Compare covers via their common adjoint datum and composite reflex field.

uses.where: Lemma4.6.22; KPZ26 Theorem7.2.19 and listed consuming items
uses.how: Compare covers via their common adjoint datum and composite reflex field.

items.name: Cover fundamental group and localization condition
items.statement: The cover can have π1(Gder) a 2-group, trivial without D^H factors, and satisfy S11.

items.name: Tame cover splitting
items.statement: The auxiliary Hodge group can be chosen to split over a tame extension of Qp.

items.name: Reflex-prime splitting in the composite field
items.statement: Every prime over p of E2 splits completely in E·E2 for the chosen cover; no unsupported equality E=E2 is asserted.

items.name: Connected cover center
items.statement: The auxiliary Hodge group can be chosen with center a torus, compatibly with S39–S41.

items.name: Torsion-free abelian coinvariants of the cover
items.statement: The auxiliary Hodge cover can additionally have X_*(Gab)_I torsion-free, by the CM-torus pushout construction.

items.name: Tame abelian-type integral model with auxiliary local model
items.statement: At p>2, every tame abelian-type datum with a connected parahoric has the model constructed by S36 and S38; it is étale locally the auxiliary Hodge local model over the original completed reflex field.

items.name: Intrinsic local-model comparison
items.statement: In S44, if p∤|π1(G2der)|, the integral model is étale locally M_(G2,X2).

items.name: DVR extension at full prime-to-p tower
items.statement: For every mixed-characteristic (0,p) DVR R over the reflex integers, S_(Kp°)(R)→S_(Kp°)(R[1/p]) is bijective at the full prime-to-p tower.

items.name: Connected adjoint diagram without D-quaternionic factors
items.statement: If the adjoint Shimura datum has no D^H factors, choose the cover with simply connected derived group and torsion-free abelian inertia coinvariants. Then the model has a Gad° torsor and smooth equivariant local-model map, and the same-field henselization comparison.

items.name: Connected diagram in the unramified fixer case
items.statement: For unramified G2, if a point x2′ has full adjoint fixer equal to the prescribed adjoint connected parahoric, the construction satisfies S47. In particular this yields the stated hyperspecial-contained application.

items.name: Reduced abelian-type special fiber
items.statement: For the tame abelian-type model at p>2 and small away-p level, the special fiber is reduced and all geometric analytic branches are normal and Cohen–Macaulay.

items.name: Normal special fiber at a geometric special vertex
items.statement: If x is special in B(G,Qp^ur), the entire special fiber of S49 is normal and Cohen–Macaulay.

items.name: Choice independence at a very special simple datum
items.statement: When Kp° is very special and Gad absolutely simple, the constructed model is independent of the auxiliary Hodge datum and embedding. General choice independence is not proved in this paper.

items.name: Nearby cycles with geometric Galois action
items.statement: For finite-type X over an excellent henselian trait of residue characteristic p and ℓ≠p, RΨ_X(F)=ibar* Rjbar*(F_etabar), with continuous Gal(Ebar/E) action.

api.name: KP18.N01.mk
api.statement: Construct the geometric trait diagram and the two site morphisms.

api.name: KP18.N01.characterisation
api.statement: Identify a stalk with the strict-local geometric Milnor-fiber cohomology.

api.name: KP18.N01.map
api.statement: Smooth pullback and proper pushforward give the stated compatible maps.

uses.how: Smooth pullback and proper pushforward give the stated compatible maps.

items.name: Semisimple Frobenius trace
items.statement: For a geometric Galois representation admitting an admissible filtration, define Trss(F,V)=Σ_i Tr(F,(gr_i V)^I); for a bounded complex take the alternating cohomology sum. Use geometric Frobenius and prove filtration independence.

api.name: KP18.N02.mk
api.statement: Construct the trace using finite-inertia graded pieces.

api.name: KP18.N02.characterisation
api.statement: Prove independence of admissible filtration and additivity in exact triangles.

api.name: KP18.N02.map
api.statement: Retain pullback and proper-support sheaf–function compatibilities.

uses.where: §4.7.1; PZ13 v4 §9.d.1 pp74–75 and listed consuming items
uses.how: Retain pullback and proper-support sheaf–function compatibilities.

items.name: Local-model splitting-field inertia is unipotent
items.statement: For the tame local model, inertia of a finite tame extension splitting G acts unipotently on nearby cycles.
items.locator: §4.7.3 citing PZ published10.9; PZ v4 Theorem9.9 pp73–74

items.name: Very-special local-model inertia is trivial
items.statement: If the vertex is very special (special before and after maximal unramified extension), splitting-field inertia acts trivially on the local-model nearby cycles.
items.locator: §4.7.3 citing PZ published10.12; v4 Proposition9.12 p74

items.name: Shimura nearby-cycle inertia
items.statement: For S49, splitting-field inertia acts unipotently on every nearby-cycle stalk; if x is very special it acts trivially.

items.name: Frobenius-compatible local trace transfer
items.statement: A connected adjoint local-model diagram yields, at y∈S(Fq), a point w∈Mloc(Fq) defined up to the adjoint connected group and equality Trss(Froby,RΨS_y)=Trss(Frobw,RΨM_w).

items.name: Parahoric Hecke algebra
items.statement: For compact open P⊂G(F), take compactly supported locally constant Qellbar-valued P-biinvariant functions with convolution using a specified Haar measure and the normalized corner idempotent.

api.name: KP18.N07.mk
api.statement: Construct compact support and convolution.

api.name: KP18.N07.characterisation
api.statement: Record Haar volume and the unit e_P=1_P/vol(P).

api.name: KP18.N07.map
api.statement: Compatible group isomorphisms and measure normalization induce algebra maps.

uses.how: Compatible group isomorphisms and measure normalization induce algebra maps.

items.name: Local-model trace function on equal-characteristic cosets
items.statement: Construct the equal-characteristic group G′/Fp((t)) and matching parahoric P′r from the same tame polynomial group. Extend the local-model semisimple trace by zero from Mloc(Fq) to G′(Fq((t)))/P′r.

api.name: KP18.N08.mk
api.statement: Construct the matching special fiber and equivariant coset embedding.

api.name: KP18.N08.characterisation
api.statement: Verify finite support and P′r-biinvariance of the zero extension.

api.name: KP18.N08.map
api.statement: Transport finite residue-field extensions with Frobenius powers.

uses.how: Transport finite residue-field extensions with Frobenius powers.

items.name: Centrality of the nearby-cycle trace function
items.statement: The function N08 lies in the center of the parahoric Hecke algebra.
items.locator: §4.7.8 citing PZ published10.14; v4 Theorem9.14 p75

items.name: Unramified equal/mixed-characteristic Hecke comparison
items.statement: For unramified G and matching parahorics, the valued-root and Frobenius data identify the double cosets and their convolution structure constants over Fq((t)) and E_r. This gives the algebra isomorphism4.7.13.

items.name: Bernstein central function for a minuscule class
items.statement: With unramified G, the source’s cocharacter μ=μ_h, residue cardinality q and chosen sqrt(q), define z_(μ,r) through the Bernstein center and its normalized spherical Satake image. The hyperspecial minuscule normalization is q^(-d/2) times the characteristic double coset.
items.locator: Theorem4.7.11; PZ v4 Theorem9.16; Haines2009 Theorem3.1.1

api.name: KP18.N11.mk
api.statement: Construct the Bernstein isomorphism through a common Iwahori and normalized idempotents.

api.name: KP18.N11.characterisation
api.statement: Specify the Satake image, geometric Frobenius and q-half normalization.

api.name: KP18.N11.map
api.statement: Prove compatibility under the same-type Hecke algebra isomorphism.

uses.where: Theorem4.7.11; PZ v4 Theorem9.16; Haines2009 Theorem3.1.1 and listed consuming items
uses.how: Prove compatibility under the same-type Hecke algebra isomorphism.

items.name: Bernstein isomorphism between parahoric and spherical centers
items.statement: For unramified G, a common Iwahori in P and a hyperspecial K yields isomorphisms of the Iwahori center with Z(H_P) and H_K by convolution with normalized idempotents, hence an isomorphism Z(H_P)≃H_K.

items.name: Unique local-model central trace with prescribed spherical image
items.statement: The normalized IC nearby-cycle trace is the unique central function whose Bernstein image is the spherical IC trace. For minuscule μ, convert to raw Qell nearby cycles with both the cohomological sign and half-Tate factor.
items.locator: PZ v4 Theorem9.16 pp75–76; KP18 Theorem4.7.11 proof

items.name: Kottwitz test-function formula for the integral Shimura model
items.statement: Let (G,X) be abelian type, p>2, G unramified, p∤|π1(Gder)|, and assume no D^H factors or Kp° contained in a hyperspecial. At y∈S(Fq), Trss(Froby,RΨS_y)=q^(d/2)z_(μ,r)(w), where d=dim Sh, r=[Fq:k_E], μ=μ_h and w is the same-field local-model point.

items.name: Siegel moduli with the chosen p-lattice chain
items.statement: Construct the Siegel integral moduli problem with the self-dual lattice-chain/polarization type of §4.1 and its universal abelian scheme at sufficiently small away-p level. PEL M2 only asserts good-level smoothness and does not by itself supply this parahoric construction.

items.name: Lang torsor triviality over a finite field
items.statement: For a smooth connected algebraic group H/Fq, every H-torsor over Fq is trivial; use the smooth henselian lift when the base is a henselian local ring with that residue field.

items.name: Serre–Tate comparison with structures
items.statement: Deformations of the polarized abelian scheme with the source’s endomorphisms and level are identified with its structured p-divisible-group deformations, preserving the Hodge tangent map.
